title: Valid parentheses
summary: Return true if every bracket in `text` is closed by the same kind of bracket, in the right order.
hints: Read `([{}])` from left to right. When you reach a closing bracket, which earlier bracket must it match: the first one opened, or the most recent one?
The most recently opened bracket must be closed first. A structure where the last item in is the first one out fits that exactly.
Push each opening bracket onto a stack. On a closing bracket, pop and check that the kinds match, failing if the stack is empty. At the end the stack must be empty.
takeaway: Any time the most recent unfinished thing must be finished first (brackets, nested tags, undo), reach for a stack. O(n) time.
